metadata.content:
*Vines [burst](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/burst) forth from the ground and bind your foe, slowly closing around them.*

| **Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike)**  |     **Main action** |
|----------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**           | **🎯 One creature** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** 10 + I damage; A < WEAK, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 15 + I damage; A < AVERAGE, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
- **17+:** 21 + I damage; A < STRONG, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)

**Effect:** While [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) this way, the target takes 10 damage at the start of each of your [turns](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).
